metadata.title: Contact FoVR Interactive | Feedback & Support
metadata.description: Get in touch with FoVR Interactive for player support, feedback, press enquiries and questions about our experiences.

contactReasons.title: Player support
contactReasons.description: Need help with one of our experiences? Tell us which one and what you are seeing.

contactReasons.title: Feedback & ideas
contactReasons.description: Share what you enjoyed, what could be better or an idea you would like us to explore.

contactReasons.title: Press & community
contactReasons.description: Questions about a release, coverage or the studio? We would love to hear from you.

text.have_a_question_about_an_experience: Have a question about an experience, need support or want to share your thoughts? Get in touch with the FoVR team.
text.tell_us_what_is_on_your: Tell us what is on your mind.
text.for_support_include_the_experience_name: For support, include the experience name, your device and what happened. For everything else, a short message is a great place to start.
text.prefer_another_way_to_reach_fovr: Prefer another way to reach FoVR?
text.form_subtitle: Questions, feedback and support for our experiences.
text.form_description: An immersive experience studio based in Brisbane, Queensland.
text.form_successBody: Your message has been received. FoVR will reply as soon as possible.
